title: Omnichannel Unified Messaging & Graph Flow Execution Pipeline
summary: ChatbotX omnichannel abstraction layer unifying 26 third-party messaging networks (WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, Zalo, Instagram, Webchat, TikTok) into a normalized message schema, contact identity graph, and DAG flow execution engine backed by Kafka and BullMQ.

references.description: Visual flow node definitions, trigger models, and compiler contracts
SDK interfaces for channel normalization, message actions, and errors
Kafka and Redis event dispatch schemas

claims.claim: Flow definitions are compiled into deterministic DAG structures (CompiledFlow) composed of typed nodes (Message, Condition, Delay, Action, Subflow, AI Agent, Webhook).
Channel adapters normalize provider-specific messaging payloads into unified Message, ProfileField, and ChannelError structures with standardized error codes.
